『현장실습 3』은 현장실습과 교과목 수강이 함께 진행되므로 반드시 수강신청을 해야 하며, 동계 계절학기의 다른 교과목(원격수업 교과목 포함)은 수강할 수 없습니다(기존에 신청한 다른 교과목은 취소 처리됨). 수강신청 및 등록금 납부 일정은 정규 일정과 다를 수 있으니 별도 안내를 반드시 확인하시기 바랍니다.
현장실습을 중도에 포기하거나 불성실하게 참여할 경우 학점이 부여되지 않으며, 실습비 지급이 제한될 수 있으니 유의하시기 바랍니다.

english: The field-practice application for 『현장실습 3』 (Field Practice 3), a course of the internship semester program (실습학기제) in the 2026 winter session, is announced below. All interested students are encouraged to apply.

In 『현장실습 3』 (Field Practice 3), the internship and the course run together, so you must register for the course. You cannot take any other course in the winter session, including online courses (any other courses you have already registered for will be cancelled). The schedules for course registration and tuition payment may differ from the regular schedule, so be sure to check the separate notice.
Please note: if you give up the internship partway through or do not take part properly, you will not receive credit, and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted.
3. Internship host organizations (※ If the table below does not display, see the file "[붙임1]" (Attachment 1)
4. How to submit the application form: by email (including your signature at the bottom of the form)
- (Round 2) 10 Nov 2026 (Tue) ~ 11 Nov 2026 (Wed) / (※ Depending on the results of Round 1 selection, Round 2 selection may not take place)
6. Submission and inquiries: 유은영 (Yoo Eun-young), Office of the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering (Building 34, Room 417, yey@snu.ac.kr, 02-880-7320)
